resources.string: Install Lock browser and Google keyword filter

Checks browser address bars against your ordered domain rules. Reads visible browser webpages and Google app content, including search results and Discover, to detect your blocked words. Per-word exceptions can allow individual blocked words; generic exception words allow the whole visible page through keyword filtering. A blocked keyword match in Google opens a screen where you can enter a new search. In browsers, tries to close the current tab, otherwise returns Home. Processing stays on this device; inspected text is not stored or sent anywhere.
